explication: agmsg is a cross-agent messaging system: agents send messages into shared SQLite storage, while hooks or monitor streams surface incoming messages. The desktop app adds terminal panes and a read-only team-room view; an optional daemon supports resident delivery, and a reference server enables remote team sync. The graph preserves these product branches. Some runtime scripts and integrations are documented but absent from the sampled source, so their internal links are limited to documented relationships.
